_doc: One entry per platform. post_url stays empty until the owner shares; then fill it and run scripts/build_all.sh (it also appears in the menu Links group). Limits are as of writing: check your account's current limit.

platforms.label: YouTube
platforms.limit_note: long form: no practical limit for this length (unverified accounts: 15 minutes per upload, verified: up to 12 hours)
platforms.post_url_hint: Paste the YouTube post link when shared

platforms.label: LinkedIn
platforms.post_url_hint: Paste the LinkedIn post link when shared

platforms.label: X
platforms.limit_note: standard accounts: 2 minutes 20 seconds (Premium accounts can post longer videos)
platforms.post_url_hint: Paste the X post link when shared

checklist: The export passed the privacy check (OCR of every 2 s, 0 sensitive lines)
The length is inside the platform limit
Captions are burned in (no separate file needed)
The ending shows the community link (watch to the end once)
You watched it in the player, version and platform noted in your feedback
